build.prompt_version: Trump Diary Weekly Thread Package Prompt v1

week.headline: The forty-ninth week of Trump’s second term did not hinge on a single order or speech.
week.summary: The forty-ninth week of Trump’s second term did not hinge on a single order or speech. It unfolded instead as a study in how a government can keep its formal shape while its inner workings are bent toward secrecy, loyalty, and fear. The surface looked familiar: agencies issued press releases, courts wrote opinions, Congress held hearings. Underneath, the levers that connect law to power were moved, one notch at a time, away from public control. The forms stayed. The function shifted.

week_summary_notes: Week 49 is best framed as a structural week: not one headline action, but the normalization of governance through secrecy, loyalty, and fear.
Administrative capture and information control form the dominant collision; together they explain how formal institutions remain visible while accountability drains away.
Weaponized law matters as a reinforcing mechanism rather than the sole lead frame.
Immigration, domestic militarization, and anti-dissent should appear as operational arenas where the week’s broader governing logic is enacted.
Resistance is present but mainly as contrast: courts and Congress still function in form, yet fail to restore public control.
Avoid overloading the week with too many parallel threads; this chapter should feel integrated around institutional function-shift, not scattered across every recurring theme.

rewrite_guidance.opening_focus: Open by stressing that the week lacked one dramatic decree but revealed something more consequential: a government whose visible procedures still run while its internal workings are bent toward secrecy, loyalty, and fear. Use administrative capture plus information control as the opening explanatory frame.
rewrite_guidance.closing_focus: Close on the contrast between intact democratic form and degraded democratic substance, with partial institutional resistance unable to prevent the continued movement of power away from public control.
continuity_emphasis_notes: Emphasize continuity from week 48: late-year authoritarianism is no longer only episodic shock but normalized administration.
Show how secrecy is not separate from governance this week; it is one of the tools by which institutions are made to serve loyalty instead of law.
Treat immigration, security, and anti-dissent as fields where the broader structural shift becomes tangible.
If using the Epstein-files sub-thread, use it as a concrete illustration of elite-protective opacity rather than as a standalone scandal detour.
Keep the week unified around the idea that the forms stayed but the function shifted.
